venue: Ben Hill Griffin Stadium, Gainesville FL
title: Week 1 vs FAU
dek: Shotgun. Baugh downhill. Hitch when they sit. Odd front. Name the shell.
watchNote: PROVISIONAL — Film Desk lock draft 2026-09-09. Charles tape wins. Fan rail stays empty until he says go.
headline: Florida kicked off, Coleman ended the first drive, and the first Gator run was the night: shotgun, Baugh downhill from the 6. Spread them. Throw it now when they sit. White’s odd front is three down plus JACK. Name the shell on the snap.

offense.body: First Gator run of the night is the night. Shotgun. Jaden Baugh 13. Middle. Nine yards from their own 6. Spread the field. Give it downhill. When the corners sit, hitch. When they cheat the run, go. The line looks more technically sound than a year ago, and the run hits with real physicality. Pistol showed up as one look. The sneak is not the offense — the only official snap that was not shotgun was the fourth-and-1 sneak, Aaron Philo 12, plus four.
bullets: Hitch when corners sit. Go when they cheat the run.
Pistol is one look. The sneak is not the offense.

defense.body: Florida kicked off. FAU first. Third-and-10 at the Florida 35, DJ Coleman is already in the window. Drive over. Brad White’s odd front is three down, JACK (Jayden Woods), STAR, Graham at WILL. If the broadcast counts four rushers, JACK is coming. Coverage is Cover 3, quarters, or man — name the shell on that snap. Coleman’s pick is that front making him hold it. Areas of opportunity in the secondary were not a pile of missed tackles. They were not on the same call. The Sledge keep: the design was sound. They lost the play.
bullets: Odd front: three down, JACK, STAR, Graham at WILL.
Coleman ends the opening drive at the Florida 35.
Secondary: same call. Not a pile of missed tackles.

specials.body: Florida never punts. Patrick Durkin from 53. FAU’s 18-yard punt starts the second Florida score.
bullets: FAU’s 18-yard punt starts the second Florida score.
